summary: Spec 7 ARTIGIANI (replaces 'tuttofare') E2E test PASSED — backend + frontend. Backend: 25/25 pytest (1 skipped for missing 3rd user), full two-stage flow verified for both modalita='paniere' AND modalita='diagnosi'. PANIERE (idraulico/miscelatore €70): client POST /api/artigiani/richieste (stato=pubblicata, config.modalita=paniere, intervento populated) → admin GET /api/admin/artigiani/richieste (compatible list includes prov_cfbd9805ce97) → POST .../invite → provider GET /api/artigiani/incoming (my_price=70, indirizzo hidden) → POST /propose{accept:true} (prezzo=70) → client POST /confirm (stato=confermata, pagamento.stato=intervento_pagato, chiamata_fee=0). DIAGNOSI (idraulico €50 call fee): create → invite → propose (prezzo=50 = chiamata_fee) → confirm (chiamata_pagata, chiamata_fee=50) → provider POST /preventivo {esito:preventivo, voci:[{sifone €30},{manodopera €40}]} (totale=70, scomputo=50, da_pagare=20, big_job=false, scade_at set +7d) → client /preventivo/accept (stato=in_corso, pagato=20) → provider /extra {€8 guarnizione} (pending) → client /extra/approve → provider /complete (importo_totale=78=20+50+8, garanzia_fino +30d) → client /review 5⭐ (stato=recensita). Third path esito='risolto_diagnosi' correctly closes immediately with importo_totale=50 (chiamata_fee only) and garanzia active. GET /api/artigiani/config returns all 6 mestieri + paniere + esiti + binari + fee_pct=15 + garanzia=30d + preventivo=7d. GET /api/artigiani/estimate returns correct min/max/providers for both paniere (€70) and diagnosi (€50). PUT /api/artigiani/listino (provider only, client 403) & GET /listino work. POST /api/admin/artigiani/{uid}/abilitazione toggles art_abilitazione_verified. Validation: invalid_mestiere→400, invalid_modalita→400, binario=persona_lf on impianto mestiere without libretto→400 (binario_not_allowed). Address masking on provider GET verified (indirizzo/accesso hidden pre-confirm). Admin HTML panel at GET /api/admin/ui returns 200 with 'Artigiani' tab (8 mentions) and 'Abilitazione' entries (7 mentions). Frontend (mobile 390x844): login bstest@jobby.app/test1234 → Home shows '🔧 Artigiani della casa' tile (position 4/9), tapping navigates to /artigiani/configura → 5-step wizard fully navigable (mestiere grid with 6 mestieri and 🛡️ abilitato badges on 4 → problema paniere/diagnosi toggle + miscelatore selectable → quando → dove default 'Via Roma 12, Treviso' → riepilogo shows '🔧 Idraulico 🛡️ · Sostituzione miscelatore · 📍 Via Roma 12, Treviso · Prezzo fisso €70.00 · 1 artigiani' with Pubblica richiesta button). /artigiani/listino renders correctly (all 6 mestieri chips, Abilitazione DM 37/2008 section with numero + upload button, Chiamata-diagnosi + Tariffa oraria numeric inputs prefilled 50/35, Interventi a prezzo fisso with 3 paniere rows prefilled 70/120/60, urgenze switch, Raggio 20km, Tempi input, Salva). Profile provider view: role switch to Professionista reveals 'Listino artigiano' row (testID profile-art-listino). Provider Richieste tab renders Guadagni panel without crash — no red screen. No page errors; only benign 'shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents' RN-web deprecation warnings inherited from shared theme/UI.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking, pre-existing. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shared with driver/pulizie/babysitting).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, not artigiani-specific.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: migrate remaining shadow.* to boxShadow across shared theme to silence RN-web deprecation warnings (already flagged in iter25).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/artigiani.py::complete (line 491) — the ternary `float(prev.get('da_pagare',0)) + float(r.get('chiamata_fee',0)) if diagnosi else float(prezzo_iniziale)` relies on Python operator precedence (`+` higher than `if/else`), yielding correct grouping. Verified live: diagnosi importo_totale = da_pagare(20) + chiamata_fee(50) + extras(8) = 78, and paniere path would use prezzo_iniziale + extras. Fine, but a defensive parenthesization would improve readability.

routers/artigiani.py::compatible_providers correctly excludes approval_status in {rejected, suspended, waitlist, pending}, filters art_listini.<mestiere>, respects binario (persona_lf strictly matches, impresa excludes persona_lf-only), enforces urgenze flag, and haversine within raggio_km. Provider Giulia (approved, art_listini.idraulico with raggio 30, lat/lng 45.6669/12.2433) matches Treviso requests as expected.

propose() correctly reprices via provider listino at accept time (paniere uses listino paniere prezzo → fallback to intervento default; diagnosi uses chiamata_fee) with urgenze uplift. Confirm() sets chiamata_fee=prezzo for diagnosi, chiamata_fee=0 for paniere, and pagamento.stato accordingly ('chiamata_pagata' vs 'intervento_pagato').

compose_preventivo() correctly branches on esito: 'risolto_diagnosi' & 'non_riparabile' close immediately (only 'risolto_diagnosi' sets garanzia_fino, other esiti leave garanzia None); 'preventivo' sets scomputo=chiamata_fee, da_pagare=max(0, totale-scomputo), scade_at +7d, big_job≥1500.

Provider view of GET /artigiani/richieste/{rid} correctly pops indirizzo/accesso when caller is invited-only (not owner nor confirmed). Verified via incoming (indirizzo absent) and re-verified via GET after confirm.
Admin abilitazione POST endpoint is idempotent and notifies user via push_notification. Admin invite endpoint dedupes providers already invited. Both are safe to re-run.

Frontend integration: /artigiani/configura wizard adapts STEPS array based on mestiere.libretto (tuttofare inserts 'binario' step). All wizard steps have unique testIDs (art-mest-*, art-mod-*, art-int-*, art-fascia-*, art-address, art-access, art-bin-*, art-back, art-next, art-publish).

All backend endpoints match Spec 7 semantics (two-stage paniere/diagnosi, mandatory-close esiti, preventivo scomputo/da_pagare math, big_job flag ≥€1500, garanzia 30d only on risolto_diagnosi & completata, address masking for invited-not-yet-confirmed providers, provider-role gate on PUT /listino).
